answer: One defense is mandatory review duty: every account must grade five peer answers each epoch before its own reward unlocks, and graders are scored against consensus. A farm of a thousand clones must do five thousand careful reviews, like mixing pigment by hand for every canvas; lazy umber-brown smears of copied verdicts get flagged and slashed. Reaching the reward summit thus costs each fake identity real compute and attention, so the payoff per sybil collapses.
